## What's in 1.0.0
- Live cellular and Wi‑Fi readings: RSRP, RSRQ, SINR and RSSI, plus band, channel and link speed.
- A best angle finder that guides you back to the strongest phone pose and heading.
- Signal maps for buildings, floors and rooms, with a heatmap and fog of war.
- Floor and building views in 3D, with your readings standing in each room.
- A street map with offline areas.
- Interference alerts for noisy cells, crowded Wi‑Fi channels and a disturbed compass.
- Updates from GitHub releases, installed only if the new APK is signed with the same key.
- No account, no analytics and no cloud backup. Every install starts blank.

## Before you install
Needs Android 10 or newer. Android asks you to allow installs from your browser or file manager the first time.

If an earlier SigNull? build is on your phone, uninstall it first. Android only installs a newer version signed with the same key, and uninstalling deletes saved maps.
